profile.address: 1111 Las Gallinas Avenue San Rafael, CA 94903
profile.summary: The Marin County Office of Education is a regional public education agency serving school districts in Marin County, California. It provides services such as special education programs, career and technical education, early childhood education, alternative education, professional development for educators, and business and personnel support for districts.
